outing.hero_prompt_english: Juyongguan Cloud Platform: a squat white marble platform with a broad central arched tunnel, finely carved stone edges and balustrades, with the Great Wall winding distantly over green-gold mountain slopes. Two adult visitors stand at ground level looking at stone architecture; no arduous hiking, no military action. Original peaceful full-bleed vertical artwork, layered filled background. No text, letters, logos, copied artwork, or invented maps. Adults in opaque everyday clothes only if people appear.
